answerlines: Colorado River (accept Green River before it is read)

clues.text: John Wesley Powell explored this river’s rapids on an 1869 expedition that began on the Green River.
In 1934, the controversial construction of the Parker Dam on this river required the National Guard to muster the Arizona Navy.
This river receives the Green River in Canyonlands National Park before flowing downstream into Lake Powell.
The Gila River flows into this river near Yuma, shortly before this river flows into the Gulf of California.
The Glen Canyon Dam on this river forms Lake Powell, the second largest man-made reservoir in the US; the largest reservoir, Lake Mead, is also on this river, behind the Hoover Dam.
Low water levels in Lake Mead, which this river flows through, have raised concern of a "dead pool" when this river will not be able to flow through Hoover Dam.
This river’s water forms Lake Mead behind the Hoover Dam, which powers much of Arizona.
Name this river of the American West that flows through the Grand Canyon and starts in the Rocky Mountains of its namesake state.
The Grand Canyon was carved by what river named for a Rocky Mountain state?
Name this river regulated by the Hoover Dam that carves out the Grand Canyon.
The Grand Ditch diverts water from the headwaters of this river in the Never Summer Mountains to the Front Range Urban Corridor.
A desalination plant on the southern end of this body of water opened 14 years late and at five times the planned cost in 1992.
At Glenwood Canyon, the Hanging Lake flows into this river, and the canal joining this river and Lake Havasu is spanned by the 1831 London Bridge.
The All-American Canal, which replaced the original Alamo Canal, provides irrigated water from this river to the Imperial Valley.
Cities along this river include Moab and Yuma, where the Gila River flows into this river.
An irrigation canal connected to this body of water overflowed for two years into a brackish sinkhole and created a now-abandoned tourist trap called the Salton Sea.
The Gila River is a major tributary of this river, which is also joined by the Green River.
This river, which serves as the source of water for irrigation of the Imperial Valley, contains the Hoover Dam, which creates Lake Mead.
This river’s Lake Mead was formed by the Glen Canyon Dam and its Lake Powell formed by the Hoover Dam.
Name this river which empties into the Gulf of California and flows through the Grand Canyon.
